entities.name: Drago Pašalić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Drago Pašalić is a Croatian former professional basketball player. He is the current technical director of Donar. Standing at 2.08 m, he played both power forward and center positions. In the beginning of his career he played for the Croatian national team. He is a one-time Croatian League and two-time Dutch League champion.
